name: 50 targeted discovery candidates — not published vehicle facts
sourcePolicy: Free sources only: Wikidata for discovery; manufacturer archives and brochures, NHTSA and EPA for evidence; Commons for separately reviewed images. No paid APIs.
goal: Research additions intended to bring Volvo, Renault, Hyundai, Kia, Volkswagen, Mazda and Mercedes-Benz to the 8-car brand threshold, while broadening Swedish/French/South Korean coverage and electrification. Targets are unverified planning tags, not publishable facts.
